functions.evidence: The complete 54-byte executable body is instruction-exact to the pinned nrf_rtc_timer.c object. Its three literal-pool words are outside the CFG body; the RTC peripheral literal is identical and the overflow_cnt/anchor words are normal final-link relocations. The normal timer archive exports z_nrf_rtc_timer_read.

The pinned source compiled for nrf5340dk_nrf5340_cpunet with the recorded config produces the same 0xf4-byte instruction sequence; only calls and BSS/literal relocations differ before final link. The normal Zephyr timer archive exports rtc_nrf_isr.

The complete 24-byte firmware body is identical to .text.event_clear in the pinned nrf_rtc_timer.c object. It is pulled with rtc_nrf_isr from the same archive member and is not an independently selectable symbol.
